labels.name: Purine-rich foods
labels.function: Red meat, organ meat and shellfish raise urate; restrict them

labels.name: Tumor lysis syndrome
labels.function: Mass cancer cell death during leukemia/lymphoma chemotherapy

labels.name: Xanthine oxidase
labels.function: Enzyme forming the end product of purine breakdown

labels.name: Allopurinol
labels.function: Preferred first-line urate-lowering drug, including in CKD

labels.name: HPRT
labels.function: Salvage enzyme deficient in Lesch-Nyhan syndrome

labels.name: Pegloticase
labels.function: IV option for refractory gout; hemolysis if G6PD deficient

labels.name: Probenecid
labels.function: Uricosuric; risk of uric acid kidney stones, weaker in CKD

labels.name: Thiazide diuretics
labels.function: Antihypertensives that cut urate excretion; replace in gout

diagrams.title: A joint with crystal deposits: composite schematic

labels.name: Monosodium urate crystals
labels.function: Needle-shaped, negatively birefringent; drive the flares

labels.name: Tophus
labels.function: Chalky yellow-white nodule with foreign-body giant cells

labels.name: Bone erosion with overhanging edge
labels.function: X-ray hallmark of chronic, long-standing gout

labels.name: Calcium pyrophosphate deposits
labels.function: Thin radiodense line at the bone end; often incidental

labels.name: Chondrocytes
labels.function: Cells whose overproduction drives pseudogout crystals

labels.name: Synovial fluid
labels.function: Aspirate it; WBC over 50,000/mm3 raises concern for sepsis

labels.name: Articular cartilage
labels.function: Soft covering of the bone ends at the joint

labels.name: Macrophage
labels.function: Phagocytoses crystals deposited in the joint

labels.name: Lysosome
labels.function: Ruptures after crystal uptake, adding to tissue injury

labels.name: IL-1
labels.function: Cytokine released after crystal uptake that drives the flare

labels.name: Neutrophil
labels.function: Predominant cell in the synovial fluid of crystal arthritis

labels.name: Microtubules
labels.function: Polymers needed for the effector cell to migrate

labels.name: Colchicine
labels.function: Flare drug; diarrhea, myopathy and cytopenias in CKD

labels.name: Cyclooxygenase
labels.function: Enzyme making the mediators of pain and swelling

labels.name: Indomethacin
labels.function: Classic flare NSAID; does not lower serum urate
